acceptance_criteria.criterion: In add mode, the label field shows "(optional)"
In edit mode without an existing label, the label field shows "(optional)"
In edit mode with an existing label, the "(optional)" hint is omitted or replaced with a mode-appropriate message (e.g., informing that clearing the label is not allowed)
All three modes render valid ES5 HTML output with no syntax errors

summary: Added `var labelHint` computed variable in `csRenderStoreModal()`, using `(isAdd || !(store && store.label))` to determine whether to show the "(optional)" span.
Replaced the hardcoded `(optional)` in the label field template with the dynamic `labelHint` variable.
In add mode and edit mode without an existing label: labelHint = ' (optional)'. In edit mode with an existing label: labelHint = '' (hint omitted).
3944 existing tests pass with zero regressions.

comments.note: The save-handler error text at config-stores.js (edit mode label validation) says 'Provide a new label or leave the current one.' — this is slightly misleading since the current label will already be pre-filled in the input. Minor DX inconsistency; out of scope for this WP.

summary: AC1: add mode — isAdd=true, ternary short-circuits to true → hint rendered correctly.
AC2: edit mode without existing label — isAdd=false, store.label falsy → !(store && store.label) is true → hint rendered.
AC3: edit mode with existing label — isAdd=false, store.label truthy → both sides false → labelHint='' (empty). AC allows omission; compliant.
AC4: pure ES5 single-quoted string concatenation, no template literals, no syntax errors. 3947 tests pass.

comments.note: Like WP-001, config-stores.js has no automated tests. The three-mode logic for labelHint was verified by code inspection only. A JSDOM-based test for csRenderStoreModal() label-field output would give future confidence.

summary: All four acceptance criteria verified by code inspection. The labelHint ternary correctly handles add mode (isAdd short-circuits to hint), edit-without-label (!(store && store.label) is true), and edit-with-label (both sides false, empty string).
